body:
claire: Heads-up: telemetry shows missing aggregates for 2026-04-18 05:10-05:40 UTC from legacy pipeline. Looks like a delayed put to the old bucket. Need a small replay + console clarity on cost impact.

omar: which shards/tenants are hit? can we scope it down?

claire: shards 31 and 32, tenants: delta-team. Rough raw rows ~90k but expect heavy dedupe.

jena: prefer sandwiched run: warm cache -> dry-run -> staged replay. Console should show per-route token estimate, and an optional "staggered routing" toggle to avoid hitting burst cap.

leah: UX request: add per-route preflight (fast) so ops can see how many tokens would go to fast vs fallback pools and an estimated peak. Also a typed-confirm if override required.

router-bot: preflight requested by claire at 1801240005. cmd: `/replay/preflight --shards 31,32 --tenants delta-team --since 2026-04-18T05:10Z --until 2026-04-18T05:40Z`

router-bot: preflight result: shard31=22.4k, shard32=18.6k, total=41.0k. est_duplicates=3.2k. route_split_estimate: fast_pool=28k, fallback=13k. slot_seconds=340.

omar: total small enough but fast_pool portion is significant. I like the staggered routing: send a percentage to fast pool and queue rest to slow pool to level the peak. avoids taking a quota override.

jena: agree. Implementation: add --route-stagger 60 (meaning 60% fast, 40% standard) and the router will respect sticky headers. Also ensure X-Idempotency-Key and X-Session-Tag propagate across lanes.

router-bot: note: current fallback preserves X-Idempotency-Key but not X-Session-Tag. will patch to forward both.

claire: ops plan: (1) run cache-warm for delta-team (2) dry-run to confirm duplicates (3) live replay with --dedupe --route-stagger 60. I can own the run if someone watches dashboards.

ops-bot: cache-warm started (cw-20260418-01). estimated saving ~12%.

ops-bot: cache-warm complete. updated preflight fast_pool=24.6k, fallback=9.8k, total_est=34.4k.

claire: dry-run now. `/replay run --shards 31,32 --tenants delta-team --mode dry-run`

ops-bot: dry-run complete. duplicates_found=3,180; token_estimate=34.2k; schema_ok.

jena: good to go. I'll monitor. launching live in 5. command: `/replay run --shards 31,32 --tenants delta-team --dedupe --route-stagger 60`

ops-bot: live replay started (r-20260418-77). routing: stagger 60% fast_pool -> 40% standard.

leah: monitoring dashboards: peak fast pool at 62% of cap briefly then leveled. fallback rate low. posting summary in 10m.

ops-bot: live replay finished. tokens_used=33,980; duplicates_removed=3,150; fast_pool_used=21,040; fallback_used=12,940; no SLO breaches.

claire: nice. follow-ups: (1) console: add route-stagger UI with per-route estimate and typed-confirm modal (leah), (2) router: patch to forward X-Session-Tag on fallback (router-bot/omar), (3) runbook: add a staggered routing example (jena).

omar: will open the router PR and add tests for header passthrough.

leah: will mock the UI and include an explanation about peak smoothing and when to use overrides.

jena: adding runbook entry now. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
